{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2002 Ohio Secretary of State''' election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect the [[Ohio Secretary of State]]. Primaries were held on May 7, 2002. Republican incumbent Ohio Secretary of State [[Ken Blackwell]] won re-election in a landslide, defeating Democratic challenger, [[Ohio House of Representatives|Ohio House Representative]] [[Bryan Flannery]], by nearly 20 percentage points.

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Ken Blackwell]], incumbent [[Ohio Secretary of State]] (1999–2007)
=== Campaign ===
Blackwell won renomination unopposed.
